Parses a standard urlset sitemap

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using Crawlberg;

var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(null);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.MapUrlsAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result);
```
